action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.99) with moderate seasonality, non-stationary, and the model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.053). Error correlation is high (mean 0.807, only 5 independent groups out of 19 models), so aggressive subset selection or fitted weights would chase noise. The near-uniform weighted combination (concentration 0.149) is effectively a robust average that hedges across the correlated-error groups, which is exactly what the unstable ranking and high redundancy call for. The leader is a seed baseline and the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable, so accepting is the correct stopping decision.
